verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI is an API-first product. Its docs describe asynchronous HTTP transcription, a synchronous HTTP endpoint, and WebSocket streaming, plus Python/TypeScript SDKs, an API reference, and an LLM Gateway on the same API. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and a community comment on the example polling loop shows hands-on API use. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on API authentication/keys and rate limits or versioning in the docs pack.
